title: Convex Polygon
description: Determine if a given set of points forms a convex polygon by checking the cross product orientation of consecutive edges.
pseudocode:
1: n = points.length
2: prevCross = 0
3: for i from 0 to n-1:
4:   p1 = points[i], p2 = points[(i+1)%n], p3 = points[(i+2)%n]
5:   cp = (p2.x - p1.x)*(p3.y - p2.y) - (p2.y - p1.y)*(p3.x - p2.x)
6:   if cp != 0:
7:     if cp * prevCross < 0: return False
8:     prevCross = cp
9: return True

steps.note: Cross product is 1, set prevCross to 1.
Cross product is 1, sign matches prevCross.
Completed all vertices, polygon is convex.
